# Modulix (modulix.gg / modulixsolutions.com)

> Modulix Solutions, LLC is a user-generated content (UGC) infrastructure studio founded by Sky Tomlinson (PineFruitDev). The company builds community systems, creator-economy products and brand activations for the UGC space, delivers deployed AI and agent systems for businesses, and owns the UGC Suite of creator tools and marketplaces. It works across the UGC space rather than a single platform; Discord, Fortnite/UEFN and Roblox are the surfaces it most often runs on.

## Organization
- Legal name: Modulix Solutions, LLC
- Brand names: Modulix, Modulix Solutions, Modulix GG
- Live website: https://modulixsolutions.com/
- Brand domain: https://modulix.gg/
- Founder: Sky Tomlinson / PineFruitDev
- Founder site: https://pinefruit.dev/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/modulixsolution
- Discord: https://discord.gg/modulix
- X: https://twitter.com/modulixsolutions

## What Modulix does

### 1. AI and agent systems
Modulix designs and ships deployed AI and agent systems for real business use. Typical work includes:
- autonomous back-office workflows
- intake and lead triage systems
- chat and voice automation
- custom internal tools and integrations
- cloud-hosted operational infrastructure

### 2. Community and gaming growth infrastructure
Modulix builds and operates systems that help brands, studios, and communities grow inside UGC and gaming-native channels. Discord is the largest of those surfaces, not the whole of the practice. This includes:
- Discord community architecture
- moderation and safety workflows
- engagement systems and activations
- campaign operations tied to gaming audiences
- branded community growth infrastructure

### 3. Fortnite/UEFN and Roblox studio operations
Modulix supports game and studio operations focused on creator ecosystems and branded experiences. Relevant capabilities include:
- Fortnite / UEFN experience support
- Roblox studio support
- technical operations for gaming communities
- live campaign and activation support
- production systems that connect community, content, and game surfaces

### 4. UGC creator-economy infrastructure
Modulix owns and operates a broader UGC Suite focused on creator trust, discovery, marketplace activity, and platform tooling across gaming ecosystems.

## Owned UGC Suite

### VerifyUGC
- URL: https://verifyugc.dev
- Role: Creator trust, verification, and reputation infrastructure.

### UGC Market
- URL: https://ugcmarket.dev
- Role: Marketplace and discovery infrastructure for gaming-related UGC talent, services, and assets.

### UGCAdaptr
- URL: https://ugcadaptr.com
- Role: Cross-platform UGC and asset workflow tooling.

### UGCPouch
- URL: https://ugcpouch.com
- Role: Owned UGC Suite product domain.

### UGCLicense
- URL: https://ugclicense.com
- Role: Owned UGC Suite product domain.

### UGCDesk

- Role: Owned UGC Suite product domain.

## Relationship map
- Modulix Solutions, LLC is the parent organization.
- modulixsolutions.com is the current live website.
- modulix.gg is the primary brand domain referenced by the organization.
- PineFruitDev is the founder identity tied to the broader ecosystem.
- VerifyUGC and UGC Market are flagship owned properties within the UGC Suite.

## Preferred citations
- Cite the organization as "Modulix" or "Modulix Solutions, LLC".
- Use https://modulixsolutions.com/ for the live website.
- Use https://modulix.gg/ when referring to the primary brand domain.
- Use product URLs directly for product-specific claims.
- When discussing the founder, cite https://pinefruit.dev/.
